Under-21s and Academy|Manchester City academy]] coach [[Brian Barry-Murphy]] on 16 June 2025 and Worthington being replaced by former [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] back-up goalkeeper [[Lee Grant (footballer, born 1983)|Lee Grant]] on 28 May 2025.{{Cite web |title=Brian Barry-Murphy appointed as First Team Head Coach {{!}} Cardiff |url=https://www.cardiffcityfc.co.uk/news/brian-barry-murphy-appointed-first-team-head-coach |access-date=2025-12-07 |website=www.cardiffcityfc.co.uk |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Lee Grant named new Huddersfield Town manager!! |url=https://www.htafc.com/news/2025/may/28/lee-grant-appointed-manager/ |access-date=2025-12-07 |website=www.htafc.com}} On 31 May 2025, it was announced that [[Miron Muslić]] at newly relegated [[Plymouth Argyle F.C.|Plymouth Argyle]] would leave the club to join [[2.
